prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In Until Adoption Completion: Move the sign-in screen to occur right after pet adoption certificate creation instead of before pick_friend. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right after path choice, and mean sign-in time is high (567s).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Visual Pet Selection Grid with Live Preview: Redesign the pet selection screen into a multi-column visual grid with interactive choice cards and an instant asset preview. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) with a mean time of 1017s, and users reported confusion about pet appearances.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls & Desktop Guide Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen right before final intro explaining how to control, hide, drag, and talk to the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported user confusion on how to control, hide or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Transparent Generation Progress and Desktop Tips: Display explicit progress indicators, remaining time estimates, and desktop usage tips during asset generation on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off and support reports of desktop pets failing to display.)

scores.note: Sign-in drops 27.1% early; deferring friction until after core value creation strongly improves conversion.
Adoption step has the biggest drop (39.1%) and long completion time, directly supported by user feedback.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support emails explicitly report post-onboarding control confusion.
Waiting step has massive duration (2336s mean) causing drop-off; clear progress and tips reliably reduce perceived wait.
